verdicts.reason: A keeps the big tan/red '04' block recognisable and puts the headline on a clean white panel; flaws: the 'ART' top row is cropped and jumbled, and a hairline/striped artifact sits at the panel edge near the top. The art is cut and crowded on the right, and the headline is small with a lot of empty white. B crops the hero tan/red numerals into unrecognisable fragments, so the original look is lost. Its white panel is oversized and ragged, with the headline off-centre inside it, and the fragmented letters at the bottom edge look messy.
